original_target.title: Pólya–Szegő conjecture for the first buckling load

answer: Affirmative announcement by Quanyu Tang and Haiqi Zhang,18October2026.
scope_comparison: The current working manuscript defines the same H02 closure and buckling Rayleigh quotient, permits sign-changing test functions, and its corollary cor:area asserts the disk lower bound for every positive-finite-area planar open set. This includes every bounded smooth local target. The pinned Palomar statement and solution repeat the actual H02 graph closure and quotient; polya_szego_buckling has no sign, topology or extra theorem-package assumption. No claim here extends to higher-dimensional buckling or to the first-two-eigenvalue ratio.
